name: PANAMY
recent: PANAMY 于 2026 年 9 月 9 日召开常年股东大会，所有决议均以投票方式通过，包括派发每股 33 仙的终期单层股息。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的季度报告。近期没有相关新闻。
notable: 常年股东大会通过派发截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止财政年度每股 33 仙的终期单层股息。
常年股东大会通过所有决议，包括董事连任。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: PANAMY held its Annual General Meeting on 9 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed by poll, including a final single-tier dividend of 33 sen per share. The company also released its quarterly report for the period ended 30 June 2026. There has been no recent news.
notable_en: The AGM approved a final single-tier dividend of 33 sen per share for the financial year ended 31 March 2026.
The AGM passed all resolutions, including the re-election of directors.
